title: Senior Product Manager - Generative AI for TV Ad Creative
jd_excerpt:
Roku, Inc. is seeking a Senior Product Manager for generative AI and creative products in its Ad Product group.

You will own a portfolio of AI-powered tools to help advertisers create, adapt, and enhance TV ad creative, including AI-generated video and format adaptations across placements. You will scale products, identify new opportunities, and collaborate with engineering, design, ad sales, operations, legal, and marketing to drive adoption and revenue while ensuring safety and brand
